job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Python GenAI Engineer with expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and AWS Cloud. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable AI-powered applications using modern GenAI frameworks, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise-grade APIs.

Roles & Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI frameworks.
Build AI/ML applications using Python and modern NLP techniques.
Develop scalable REST APIs using FastAPI for AI model integration.
Work with LLMs such as GPT, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral.
Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
Develop intelligent AI agents using LangChain and LlamaIndex.
Deploy and manage AI solutions on AWS cloud platforms.
Implement CI/CD pipelines for automated model deployment and monitoring.
Containerize applications using Docker and support production deployments.
Optimize model performance, scalability, and response latency.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and business teams to deliver AI-driven solutions.

Must-Have Skills

Python, AWS, Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, Agentic AI, FastAPI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Docker, CI/CD.

Good-to-Have Skills

Azure, GCP, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, Kubernetes, MLOps, Data Engineering.
